{"metadata":{"description":"DSH 插件：定时循环（/loop 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条）。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add 安装","id":"gh:1330041547","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-loop","slug":"vlln/dsh-loop","topics":["dsh","dsh-plugin","plugin","ui"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DSH 插件：定时循环（/loop 命令 + loop 工具 + 活动状态条）。官方 bundle 插件，dsh plugin --profile web add 安装"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"loop"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Scheduled loop plugin: `/loop` command + `loop` tool (self-adjusting by the model) + active status b"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ar on the chat page, with support for multiple concurrent loops"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"Delivers a prompt to the current agent at a fixed interval — ideal for polling, PR babysitting, and "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"build-fix-test cycles. Aligned with Claude Code's `/loop` semantics, **multiple loops can run concur"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"rently in a single session**. Delivered as an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient c"},{"id":"p5s4","text":"e session**. Delivered as an official **bundle plugin** (`dsh.bundle` + dshClient channel), 0 patch."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"## Preview"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"**Tool** (registered via `defineTool`, the model can self-adjust on every turn):"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Tool | Description |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"| `loop` | start (start a new loop) / stop (stop a specific one or all) / status / list (list loops "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"in the current session) |"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Commands** (user side):"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"| Command | Description |"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"| `/loop [interval] <prompt>` | Start a new loop (interval `5m`/`30s`/`1h`/`2d` or a bare number = m"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"inutes; bare `/loop` uses the built-in maintenance prompt) |
| `/loop list` | List all loops in the "},{"id":"p13s3","text":"current session (with ids) |
| `/loop stop <id>` / `/loop stop` | Stop a specific loop / stop all |"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"`/loop` replies (the command-palette title/description, `list` / usage / stop output) follow the **U"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"I language**: the client half relays its active locale to the plugin, so they render in Chinese or E"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"nglish to match the interface. Headless runs with no client in sight keep English."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"**UI** (dock slot above the input box on the chat page):"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| Feature | Description |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| Active status bar | Single loop: `● ⟳ looping · <prompt> · 5m · next in 23s`; multiple loops colla"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"pse into a count bar "N loops running · expand", click to expand the list |
| `/` menu row | Typing "},{"id":"p17s3","text":"`/` in the composer shows the ⟳ icon at the left of the `/loop` row (same position and size as every"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" other command row), with a localized title ("Loop" / "循环") |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Settings"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"The plugin ships a settings card on **Settings → Plugins → this bundle's page** (official `plugins.b"},{"id":"p19s2","text":"undle.config` slot, keyed by the bundle package name `@vlln/dsh-loop`; the settings namespace is `ds"},{"id":"p19s3","text":"h-loop`, the id of the entry that exports the `Config` schema). **Each tool gets its own row with an"},{"id":"p19s4","text":" official-looking Switch:**"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"| Setting | Default | Effect |"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Whether to **inject** the `loop` tool into the model | on | When off, the `loop` tool is **not reg"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"istered** for agents: the model can no longer see or call it (`tools.schemas` has no `loop`). The `/"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"loop` command (user side) and the status bar are unaffected. |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"The card fields are driven by the client `LOOP_TOOL_FIELDS` table, mirrored one-to-one by the Node-s"},{"id":"p22s2","text":"ide tool definition table — adding a tool means adding one entry on each side, and the settings card"},{"id":"p22s3","text":" grows a new switch row automatically."},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Changes apply as soon as you **save** (the schema's leaves are marked `.volatile()`: the host commit"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"s in place without remounting the entry and emits `loader/volatile-update`) — the plugin re-reads th"},{"id":"p23s3","text":"e snapshot and registers/unregisters the affected tools on the fly, so new sessions pick it up witho"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ut a restart. Tool schemas are resolved live at every session/prompt assembly (there is no per-sessi"},{"id":"p23s5","text":"on snapshot): in-flight sessions also see the change from their next turn, and turning a tool off dr"},{"id":"p23s6","text":"ops it from `tools.schemas` immediately, so a model that called it earlier can no longer reach it (t"},{"id":"p23s7","text":"hey can only reconcile that through the turn record). The `/loop` command (user side) and the status"},{"id":"p23s8","text":" bar are unaffected."},{"id":"p24s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"**Recommended: one-line install from npm** (build artifacts ship in the package, no build triggered)"},{"id":"p25s2","text":"*Recommended: one-line install from npm** (build artifacts ship in the package, no build triggered):"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p27s1","text":"Or from a local directory (when you have the source): `git clone`, then `cd dsh-loop && dsh plugin -"},{"id":"p27s2","text":"-profile web add .`."},{"id":"p28s1","text":"## Compatibility"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"| dsh version | Status |"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"| `0.2.0-rc.2` | ✅ Verified (migrated against 0.2.0 on 2026-10-03; command surface re-checked 2026-1"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"0-15) |
| Other versions | ⚠️ Unverified — if the `/loop` menu row loses its icon and localized titl"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"e after a dsh upgrade (the command itself still works), upstream renamed an internal client command-"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"surface method and the plugin silently falls back to the official fallback look |"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"After installing, **restart web** for it to take effect (bundles are composed at startup); afterward"},{"id":"p31s2","text":"s you can disable/enable it from the "Plugins" panel on the settings page (takes effect at runtime +"},{"id":"p31s3","text":"sable/enable it from the "Plugins" panel on the settings page (takes effect at runtime + persisted)."},{"id":"p32s1","text":"## Usage"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p34s1","text":"Loops live in the current harness process and disappear when the process exits (not persisted across"},{"id":"p34s2","text":" restarts, consistent with Claude Code `/loop`)."},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## Development"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"- Node half: `src/index.mjs` (commands/tool/loops status route `/plugins/dsh-loop/loops`)
- client: "},{"id":"p37s2","text":"`src/client/index.tsx` (dock slot status bar)"},{"id":"p38s1","text":"## License"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"MIT License (example plugin of the DSH ecosystem)."}],"truncated":false}
